description: This file defines the CRServiceWorker class, which extends the Worker class to implement Chromium-specific service worker functionality within the Playwright testing framework. It manages network interception, console message handling, session management, and lifecycle events for service workers in Chromium browser contexts.

classes.name: CRServiceWorker
classes.description: A Chromium-specific extension of the Worker class managing service worker behavior, network settings, and event handling within Playwright.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of CRServiceWorker, setting up session event handlers, network management, and lifecycle hooks.

methods.name: didClose
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the service worker closes, including removing network sessions and disposing of sessions.

methods.name: updateOffline
methods.description: Updates the offline mode state in the network manager based on browser context options.

methods.name: updateHttpCredentials
methods.description: Updates HTTP credentials for network requests from the browser context settings.

methods.name: updateExtraHTTPHeaders
methods.description: Sets extra HTTP headers for network requests based on browser context options.

methods.name: updateRequestInterception
methods.description: Configures request interception according to current interception needs.

methods.name: needsRequestInterception
methods.description: Determines whether request interception is enabled and needed based on context settings.

methods.name: reportRequestFinished
methods.description: Emits an event indicating a network request has finished with its response.

methods.name: requestFailed
methods.description: Emits an event when a network request fails.

methods.name: requestReceivedResponse
methods.description: Emits an event when a network response is received.

methods.name: requestStarted
methods.description: Emits an event signaling the start of a network request and potentially handles routing.

ctags.name: message
ctags.pattern: /^      const message = new ConsoleMessage(null, this, event.type, undefined, args, toConsoleMessa/
